name: VAULTDIVE ARENA: Group Immersion Combat Network
description: A chain of full-body immersion pod arcades where groups of up to sixteen players share synchronized combat and exploration scenarios across persistent virtual worlds. Pods are stacked four stories high in repurposed transit hubs throughout Tier 2-3 districts, with cheaper 'open rack' pods on the lower floors and premium isolation suites above. The network's flagship scenario, IRONGATE SIEGE, has run continuously since launch with a rotating competitive ladder that pays out in Φ vouchers.
story_hooks: A competitive pod team discovers their opponent has been feeding live tactical data from the real Shelf into their scenario — someone is using the game to plan something.
A night-shift maintenance worker finds a pod that has been occupied for eleven days straight, the occupant alive but unresponsive, their BCI broadcasting an unknown signal.
A runner is hired to retrieve a corporate whistleblower whose only known location is a persistent anonymous avatar inside the IRONGATE SIEGE ladder.
